name: rss-digest-1.0.0
description: Fetch and digest RSS feeds from Substack and other sources. Manage feed list, fetch recent articles, and generate daily digests.

tools.name: fetch_rss_digest
tools.description: Fetch recent articles from all (or specific) RSS feeds and return a digest. Use this for daily briefings or catching up on newsletters. Returns title, author, date, summary, and link for each article.

feed_name.description: Optional: fetch only this feed by name (e.g. 'houseofgreen'). Omit to fetch all feeds.

hours.description: Only include articles published within this many hours (default: 24). Use 168 for a week.

max_per_feed.description: Maximum articles to return per feed (default: 5)

tools.name: list_rss_feeds
tools.description: List all configured RSS feeds with their names, URLs, and categories.

tools.name: add_rss_feed
tools.description: Add a new RSS feed to the digest. Supports Substack (auto-generates URL from name), or any direct RSS/Atom URL.

name.description: Short name / identifier for the feed (e.g. 'houseofgreen', 'techcrunch')

url.description: Full RSS feed URL. For Substack, you can omit this and just provide the name — the URL will be auto-generated as https://<name>.substack.com/feed

tools.name: remove_rss_feed
tools.description: Remove an RSS feed from the digest by name.

name.description: The name of the feed to remove
